05 / Authority stays visible

Prepared is a state.
Approved is a decision.

A dossier organizes evidence. It does not replace importer responsibility or professional judgment.

Human disposition

A potential match stays unresolved until a reviewer examines identifiers and records a reason.

Reversible proposals

Reject or revise an assumption with evidence. The history keeps the alternative and the reason.

Dated sources

See versions, dates, and coverage. Stale data opens a review task rather than a silent update.

A clear stop

No filing, funds transfer, external messages, or ERP and bank writes. Export is a local packet.

Before the next step

A few useful questions.

A clear boundary is part of a useful review.

All questions
Is SKUDocket an operating product?

SKUDocket is a research-stage concept. This website demonstrates a proposed workflow with fictional records. Demand, accepted pricing, live integrations, and production compliance coverage have not been demonstrated.

Who is this for?

US importer-of-record compliance leads handling recurring goods, multiple suppliers, and a customs broker. The starting test is one permissioned repeat-SKU US import lane.

Does it replace our customs broker?

The proposed dossier is prepared for broker review. The importer retains reasonable-care responsibility, and broker or counsel judgment remains part of the workflow.

Are the classifications binding?

No. Suggested rationales are nonbinding. The preview leaves code candidates unassigned; actual classification requires detailed facts and appropriate professional review.

A bounded next step
